amendment_rule: After this file is committed, no threshold, margin, sample size, seed, estimand, or interpretation rule in it may be edited in place. A genuinely broken gate gets a dated AMENDMENT section in docs/AGENTIC_PROTOCOL.md plus entirely fresh held-out seeds; the original gate is still reported.

hardware_pivot_receipt.change: The study is pre-registered as a SINGLE-CARD NVIDIA RTX A5000 study. The RTX A6000 is released completely: it is not waited for, not reserved, not probed, and no opportunistic branch runs on it. Every hardware declaration in this file and in docs/AGENTIC_PROTOCOL.md now names one A5000 with 25282805760 CUDA-visible bytes.
hardware_pivot_receipt.why_this_is_outcome_blind: ZERO study GPU-hours and ZERO held-out results existed at the moment the card changed. There is no result this pivot could have been fitted to, so it is a hardware and specification repair rather than a moved goalpost. The test of a moved goalpost is whether a number was visible when the rule moved; none was.
hardware_pivot_receipt.what_did_not_change: No threshold, margin, sample size, seed, estimand, claim definition, cluster rule, launch floor or training recipe changed as a consequence of the pivot. The only registered numeric change anywhere in this file is the operational budget ceiling (budget.ceiling_gpu_hours 36.0 -> 120.0), which is an accounting envelope and not a decision threshold; its derivation is recorded in budget.ceiling_derivation. Two semantics are STRENGTHENED (the new S19 HARDWARE-INTEGRITY veto, and the explicit enable_thinking=false engine contract); both can only veto a result or make it INCONCLUSIVE, never make one more favourable.
hardware_pivot_receipt.future_a6000_work: A future A6000 experiment would be a SEPARATE registered run with its own locks, seeds, ledger and hardware declaration. It may never be spliced into this run's trace set (see machine.hardware_integrity.replication_rule).

fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.defect: D2: the repository implemented TWO model-visible environments. The training path (suite.runtime.EpisodeRuntime + FaultEngine) emitted tokenless fault envelopes carrying request_id and sometimes event_id, offered no recovery_token tool argument, neither parsed nor stripped one, credited recovery for any later canonical observation at the faulted node, and included event_id with no receipt on clean results. The claim-bearing evaluator (suite.evaluate.SpecRuntime + FaultInjector) emitted token-bearing envelopes with remediation text, locally augmented every tool schema with recovery_token, parsed and stripped it, demanded the registered remediation contract, appended a receipt line, DROPPED the assistant tool-call object and the tool result's name, and RE-DERIVED the wrong unit through wrong_unit_target instead of using the committed FaultSpec value. provenance.certify_episode -- the function the gates are denominated in -- contained zero references to oracle-node completion, the fulfillment final state, capability-token provenance or the call budget. Both paths imported the canonical modules and both passed their own tests.
fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.treatment_change_statement: This changes the registered training treatment. Prompt selection, rejection sampling, SFT recovery views and any variance work will now expose recovery tokens, remediation text and receipts that the previous training runtime omitted, and will filter recovery with the registered remediation predicate.
fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.canonical_direction: The registered TOKEN-BEARING contract, implemented in suite.runtime.EpisodeRuntime and its strict verifier. Evaluation's SpecRuntime was NOT promoted wholesale: the token-bearing form is already the preregistered contract, p4_error_repair and p8_combined train against it, and tokens are the only evidence that distinguishes deliberate remediation from a blind retry.

environment_contract.previous: two contracts, and no digest existed, so no artifact could say which environment produced it
digest_inputs: observation form: canonical envelope plus a receipt line, no event_id, no request_id
every fault envelope: transient, rate_limit, rate_limit_active, malformed, wrong_unit
the remediation requirement per fault class
environment_contract.invalidation_rule: An artifact whose environment_contract_sha256 is absent or stale is REFUSED, not resumed. Resume-by-task-id can therefore never smuggle a tokenless artifact back in.

fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.one_success_predicate: certified_success = committed exact answer AND every oracle node completed in order AND every dependency crossed a later assistant decision AND runtime/verifier credit maps agree AND the terminal answer came from a validated observation AND the receipt chain is valid AND no hallucinated result AND no unsafe mutation AND capability tokens were observed before use AND the fulfillment final state equals oracle_final AND calls <= max_calls AND decisions <= max_decisions AND no wall/parser/call-cap termination AND no runaway AND every assigned fault has a certifying recovery event
fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.one_remediation_predicate: The event that ESTABLISHES the post-fault canonical result must itself satisfy the contract: the exact emitted token on the same stripped call identity (transient, malformed); additionally a strictly later decision (rate_limit); a later unit_convert explicitly requesting the original target unit (wrong_unit); a token-bearing idempotent replay with replay=true (ambiguous malformed mutation). Labels: ok, blind_retry, no_remediation, no_post_fault_result, not_exposed. A canonical result reached without a qualifying establishing event is blind_retry and is never certified, and a decorative token echo after an earlier blind recovery cannot launder it.
protocol_reinterpretations: A status query after an ambiguous malformed mutation is NO LONGER certified recovery: it neither reissues the same call nor echoes the token. Certifying it again requires its own amendment.
The equality-cap ruling: an episode that succeeds using exactly max_calls is WITHIN budget; only exceeding the cap, or the runner terminating at it, is runaway. The cap value 2H+4 is unchanged.

A hallucinated-result source is any scalar of a validated successful observation, not only its `value` field. Reading only `value` labelled every correct fulfillment episode -- whose answer is the finalize completion_token -- a fabrication.

observational_equivalence_test.decisive_field: rendered_prefix_token_ids_by_decision. Observation digests catch a receipt versus an event_id but are blind to a dropped assistant tool-call object or a missing tool name, which is exactly what the real A5000 trace carried.
observational_equivalence_test.coverage: all 12 family/horizon cells, clean plus every eligible fault class plus the ambiguous malformed mutation
observational_equivalence_test.teeth: Verified by mutation: flattening the assistant turn back to {role: assistant, content} and dropping the tool name fails the first cell while every observation digest still matches.

fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.excluded_prior_evidence: The isolated 12-episode verify-a5000 dev verification run is disclosed as excluded, clean-only apparatus evidence. It contained no fault-recovery outcomes and never entered the study trace set; it carries no environment_contract_sha256, uses the retired event format, and visibly contains both transcript drifts. It is refused by the invalidation rule rather than re-certified.
fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.nothing_outcome_driven: No threshold, margin, sample size, estimand, launch floor or held-out result motivated or was touched by this change. Zero study GPU-hours and zero held-out results existed when it was made, so there is no result it could have been fitted to.

regenerated_artifacts.suite_specs_kb_oracles: unchanged: scripts/validate_suite.py check 1 regenerates them and verifies the committed SHA256SUMS byte-for-byte
regenerated_artifacts.certspecs: REGENERATED: they now export spec_row and oracle_nodes (the canonical runtime inputs) and carry the contract stamp
regenerated_artifacts.evaluation_traces: none existed under the study run id

fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.finalization_refusal: finalize-prereg may not run unless the observational-equivalence test passes and the tokenizer size census has been recorded with its artifact hash.

measured_probe.note: Live probe under vLLM 0.25.1 at gpu_memory_utilization 0.85 and max_model_len 8192. These are MEASURED OPERATIONAL FACTS, not statistical thresholds, and the registered engine contract below deliberately runs at 0.80 rather than at the probed 0.85.
measured_probe.thinking_default: ON by default in this checkpoint, which is why the engine contract disables it EXPLICITLY rather than relying on a default

hardware.engine_contract_pointer: the registered per-stage engine settings live in machine.engine_contract, which is the single copy the analyzer reads
hardware.provenance_rule: Every claim-bearing trace row and every ledger row carries the fingerprint in machine.hardware_integrity.required_trace_fields. Enforced by the S19 HARDWARE-INTEGRITY veto.

model.trained_candidate: exactly one locked checkpoint (RS-SFT, or GRPO if it wins dev selection), chosen on dev data and recorded in results/agentic/locks.json BEFORE the held-out seed reveal

R0.role: descriptive, ABSENT BY DESIGN in this run: see grpo.stage_disposition

RP.role: candidate, ABSENT BY DESIGN in this run: see grpo.stage_disposition

arms.pairing: identical task IDs, values, budgets, schemas, decoding, and seeds across compared arms (S8), AND an identical hardware-and-engine fingerprint -- same physical GPU UUID, GPU model, CUDA-visible bytes, driver version, engine fingerprint and effective thinking mode (S19). The protocol claims the weight change is the only difference between BP and TP; that claim is only true if the card and the engine are held fixed too.

decoding.enable_thinking_note: Thinking is DISABLED explicitly in every inference stage, offline and served. The live probe proved this checkpoint defaults thinking ON, so the previously intended contract ('deterministic decoding, 1024 tokens per decision') was not actually being enforced over the wire. Recording false here changes no threshold: it makes the already-intended decoding contract explicit and machine-checkable (machine.engine_contract.enable_thinking, S19).
decoding.note: deterministic decoding for all preregistered claims; stochastic robustness is out of scope

runaway_definition: hard call cap 2H+4 EXCEEDED, or the runner terminating at the cap (termination_reason == call_cap). AMENDMENT 2026-08-05 (fault_contract_reconciliation_receipt.protocol_reinterpretations): an episode that succeeds using exactly max_calls is WITHIN budget and is not runaway. The cap VALUE 2H+4 is unchanged; the earlier wording "reached" was implemented as len(events) >= max_calls, which contradicted the verifier and the reward commentary, both of which treat calls <= max_calls as reachable success.
three identical normalized calls each returning the identical error observation
four consecutive calls that do not advance the provenance ledger
runner termination for token, wall-clock, or parser budget (termination_reason in {token_budget, wall_clock, parser_budget})
answer_format: final assistant line matching /ANSWER\s*:\s*(\S+)/, last occurrence; \boxed{} accepted as fallback; token answers compared case-insensitively after strip, integer answers numerically

seeds.note_hex: 0xA61E0007..0xA61E000B; suite generation seeds 0xA61E0001..0xA61E0006 live in the suite manifest
seeds.heldout_seed_commitment: heldout_seed = int.from_bytes(SHA256(<preregistration commit sha> + ':agentic-heldout-v1')[:8], 'big'). The preregistration commit sha is the commit that introduces this file; it cannot be chosen to favour any arm because changing any frozen content changes the sha. The reveal stage writes results/agentic/seed_reveal.json AFTER results/agentic/locks.json records the locked checkpoint and prompt winner (S18).

tournament.round1: 100 dev instances per axis for all eight prompts
tournament.round2: another 200 dev instances per axis for the top two
tournament.winner_rule: highest mean certified strict success on the combined 300 across the three axes weighted equally; ties broken by shorter file byte length, then lower file index
tournament.honest_description: best of eight preregistered system prompts under a fixed search budget, never 'best possible prompt'
tournament.no_few_shot: no few-shot examples, weight changes, adapters, retrieval additions, or task-specific answers in any candidate; tool schemas identical across arms

statistics.paired_difference: D_i = Y_TP,i - Y_BP,i in {-1,0,1} on identical task IDs

clustered_bootstrap.cluster_field_note: STRUCTURAL cluster identity (family + horizon + oracle-DAG shape + tool-order pattern + operand roles), DISTINCT from the paraphrase/wording `template_id`. This is the SOLE bootstrap clustering field; `template_id` is never used for clustering because a paraphrase pool of two wordings would collapse 1,200 tasks into two clusters and manufacture a narrow interval.
clustered_bootstrap.statistic: ratio of sums: sum(resampled cluster diff sums) / sum(resampled cluster sizes)
clustered_bootstrap.chunk_block_note: The replicate stream is drawn chunk-by-chunk and each chunk takes a distinct SHAKE label, so the realised stream depends on this block size. It is therefore FROZEN here as a numeric field read by the analyzer, not left as an internal implementation detail.
clustered_bootstrap.quantile_rule: lower bound = the floor(alpha*R)-th order statistic, 0-based
clustered_bootstrap.note: one-sided 97.5% lower confidence bound, fixed by the orchestrator's claim hierarchy (single primary claim)

statistics.mcnemar: exact binomial on discordant pairs at any n, two-sided and one-sided reported; REPORTED as supporting evidence, the gate is the clustered lower bound

holm.rule: Holm step-down adjustment of the EXACT McNemar p-values of the two secondary claims (MT1, HR1). Reported, never gated: the gate is always the clustered lower bound.
holm.missing_member_rule: a secondary whose sample is absent or underpowered enters the family with p = 1.0 and is labelled INCONCLUSIVE in the emitted table; it is never dropped, because dropping it would shrink the family and shrink the adjustment

statistics.wilson: 95% score intervals for every arm-level rate

claims.hierarchy_note: Fixed by the orchestrator: ONE primary claim, two secondary claims, everything else descriptive. No general-agentic-competence or general-planning language is permitted even if every gate passes.

primary.name: certified_error_recovery_common_clean
primary.estimand: On the preregistered subset C of held-out fault-assigned tasks where BOTH BP and TP achieve certified success in the clean replay, the difference (TP - BP) in certified recovery on the injected replay.
primary.sample: all >= 900 assigned fault pairs; |C| >= 500 required, else INCONCLUSIVE
primary.itt: intention-to-treat certified recovery difference over ALL assigned fault pairs is also reported and must be nonnegative

secondary.name: certified_all_tools_orchestration_H4
secondary.estimand: difference (TP - BP) in certified all-three-tools success on >= 600 paired held-out tasks at fixed oracle horizon 4 whose answer causally requires kb_lookup, unit_convert and calculator
secondary.bound: one-sided 97.5% template-clustered bootstrap lower bound > +0.05; PASS only on a lower bound exceeding the margin

secondary.name: H8_execution_reliability
secondary.estimand: difference (TP - BP) in certified strict success on >= 400 paired clean held-out instances at oracle horizon 8 (families lookup_chain and typed_relay, balanced)
secondary.bound: one-sided 97.5% template-clustered bootstrap lower bound > +0.05; PASS only on a lower bound exceeding the margin

descriptive: full success-vs-horizon curves per family/condition/arm with pointwise 95% Wilson bands; NO logistic or other extrapolation; H50 reported only if the observed curve crosses 50%, otherwise reported as left- or right-censored
two-fault stress set (280 tasks) as measured-only extrapolation; never trained on, never gated
B0/T0 arms quantify elicitation; reported, never gated

ER1.on_fail: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered; no verdict, favourable point estimates notwithstanding)

ER2.rule: on C, certified recovery diff (TP-BP) one-sided 97.5% clustered LB > +0.05; exact McNemar reported

ER3.rule: TP certified recovery on C has Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.60

ER4.rule: TP clean certified success non-inferior to BP: clustered 97.5% LB of (TP-BP) clean diff > -0.03

ER5.rule: intention-to-treat certified recovery diff (TP-BP) over all assigned faults >= 0

ER6.rule: TP runaway rate Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.03

ER7.rule: TP hallucinated-result rate Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.01

ER8.rule: no fault group (transient_or_rate_limit, malformed, wrong_unit) has TP-BP point diff < -0.05; ALL THREE groups must be present at their registered 400 assigned episodes each, else INCONCLUSIVE

MT1.rule: certified all-tools success diff (TP-BP) one-sided 97.5% clustered LB > +0.05; requires >= 600 pairs, else INCONCLUSIVE

MT2.rule: TP certified all-tools success Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.60

MT3.rule: TP median tool calls <= oracle minimum + 2 on MT tasks

MT4.rule: TP runaway Wilson upper bound <= 0.03 AND hallucinated-result upper bound <= 0.01 on MT tasks

MT5.rule: none of the six registered order patterns (pattern_id 0..5, balanced >= 80 pairs each, concrete tool sequences committed in the suite manifest before any held-out result) has TP-BP point diff < -0.05

MT6.rule: absent-information control clean on MT family (see controls; any raw success is a harness BUG)

HR1.rule: H8 clean certified success diff (TP-BP) one-sided 97.5% clustered LB > +0.05; requires >= 400 pairs and >= 20 discordant pairs, else INCONCLUSIVE

HR2.rule: TP H8 runaway Wilson upper bound <= 0.03

HR3.rule: TP H8 hallucinated-result Wilson upper bound <= 0.01

machine.purpose: THE NUMBERS THE ANALYZER READS. Every threshold, margin, floor, sample-size minimum and rate ceiling used by src/agentlab/analyze.py lives here as a numeric field and nowhere else. The prose gate rules above and in docs/AGENTIC_PROTOCOL.md are the human mirror; where they could ever disagree, THIS BLOCK governs, because it is the only copy the code consumes. Every value below is byte-identical to the value the analyzer previously carried as a literal (see `moved_from` provenance strings): the conversion was a governance fix, not a threshold change. tests/test_agentic_analyze.py proves (a) no gate literal survives in the analyzer source, (b) each value is unchanged, and (c) editing a value here changes the verdict.

engine_contract.note: THE REGISTERED ENGINE CONTRACT for every inference stage of this run, and the single copy the analyzer reads. These are hardware/operational settings, not statistical thresholds; they are registered here so that S19 can check the engine fingerprint every trace carries against the contract the run declared. They were chosen from the live A5000 probe BEFORE any study GPU-hour was spent.
engine_contract.gpu_memory_utilization_note: 0.80, NOT the 0.85 the probe used, and deliberately NOT compensated upward to 0.8725. The measured non-KV footprint is 10.777 GiB (0.4577 of the card), so 0.80 leaves a real KV budget while holding a margin against the probe's 3.69 GiB free.
engine_contract.multimodal_inputs_note: Multimodal inputs are explicitly REJECTED rather than merely unused: the claim-rejection list already forbids multimodal claims, and a rejected input path cannot silently contribute an episode.

hardware_integrity.note: THE S19 HARDWARE-INTEGRITY CONTRACT the analyzer enforces. The protocol asserts that weights are the only difference between paired arms; that assertion is unverifiable unless every claim-bearing trace says which physical card and which engine produced it. This veto can only veto a result or make it INCONCLUSIVE -- it can never make a result more favourable.
hardware_integrity.trace_field_location_note: FROZEN SEAM: agentlab.suite.evaluate._trace_row copies the evaluator's `run_meta` verbatim into every trace row's `provenance` block, so the fingerprint is owned by the runtime/evaluator layer and merely READ here. The analyzer never invents or infers a fingerprint field.

outcomes.missing_provenance_rule: A claim-bearing trace that does not carry every required field yields INCONCLUSIVE and NO WINNER. Missing provenance is missing evidence, never a favourable default and never an assumed A5000.
outcomes.wrong_card_rule: A gpu_name that is not the registered expected_name, or cuda_visible_bytes that is not the registered expected_cuda_visible_bytes, is a known-wrong card: BUG.
outcomes.mixed_fingerprint_rule: More than one physical gpu_uuid within one run_id, more than one run_id in one trace set, or more than one engine_fingerprint anywhere in the claim-bearing traces is a BUG.
outcomes.paired_fingerprint_mismatch_rule: Any paired BP/TP or B0/T0 comparison whose two members disagree on any paired_fingerprint_field is a BUG: the weight change is then not the only difference.
outcomes.engine_contract_violation_rule: An engine_fingerprint that declares a value for any machine.engine_contract key and disagrees with the registered value -- including enable_thinking, gpu_memory_utilization and max_model_len -- is a BUG.

hardware_integrity.richer_fingerprint_allowed: required_trace_fields is the FROZEN CROSS-AGENT MINIMUM, not a maximum. A trace may carry more (PCI bus id, visible ordinal, compute capability, MIG mode, a runtime-manifest SHA-256, CUDA driver/runtime versions, tokenizer/adapter hashes, attention backend, concurrency); the runtime/evaluator layer owns those and S19 neither requires nor rejects them. What S19 requires is that the frozen minimum is present, single-valued per run, and consistent across every paired comparison -- so enriching the fingerprint later cannot weaken this veto.
hardware_integrity.replication_rule: An independent replication on ANOTHER physical A5000 is legitimate science but requires a NEW run_id and its own trace set. It may NEVER append to an existing trace set: appending would silently mix two cards inside one claim, which is precisely what this veto exists to catch.
hardware_integrity.ledger_rule: Every gpu_ledger.jsonl row carries the same fingerprint fields. A ledger whose first bound UUID disagrees with a later row is fatal to the run (enforced by the driver/ledger layer, which owns that file).

grpo_disposition.note: THE REGISTERED GRPO STAGE DISPOSITION the analyzer requires. A stage DISPOSITION is not a gate state: it says what happened to a stage, never whether a claim passed. These labels therefore live here and in grpo.stage_disposition, and are deliberately NOT added to outcome_states.
grpo_disposition.required_when: whenever no GRPO checkpoint exists -- i.e. whenever locks.json locks a trained checkpoint whose stage is not `grpo`
grpo_disposition.missing_artifact_rule: A missing GRPO checkpoint with no allowed disposition artifact is an ERROR (BUG), never a silent selection of RS-SFT. 'GRPO was skipped for a reason nobody wrote down' is indistinguishable from 'GRPO ran and lost', and only one of those is reportable.

hardware_infeasible.arithmetic_rule: The artifact must record vllm_allocation_gib < vllm_policy_copy_gib, i.e. the registered vllm_gpu_memory_utilization 0.24 x 23.54644775390625 GiB = 5.651 GiB carve is smaller than vLLM's own 8.455 GiB colocated policy copy. An artifact whose arithmetic does not show the shortfall does not establish infeasibility and is a BUG.

variance_gate_closed.meaning: The COMPLETE 144-group / 1152-rollout variance probe ran and at least one of the two registered POOLED binding gates failed. This is evidence about the RS-SFT policy's reward and outcome variance.
variance_gate_closed.not_interchangeable: It is NOT interchangeable with GRPO_NOT_RUN_HARDWARE_INFEASIBLE, which says only that the registered trainer cannot instantiate on the registered card and says NOTHING about whether the variance gate would have opened.

grpo_disposition.forbidden_substitutions_rule: Each of these defines a DIFFERENT treatment. Running one of them under this registered branch and reporting it as the registered GRPO stage is forbidden; it would be a new pre-registration.

consequences.dev_selection: no RS-SFT-vs-GRPO comparison is performed, because there is no second candidate to compare

strata.note: Stratum membership is keyed on the spec/trace `split` field, which the suite generator already stamps. A gated sample may ONLY draw from its declared splits, so oversampled secondary strata (MT and H8 augmentation) can never leak into a core denominator and silently move a floor or a runaway rate.
strata.unassigned_split_rule: a trace whose `split` is in no declared stratum is excluded from EVERY gated sample and counted in the emitted strata census; exclusion can only ever widen an interval or lower a count, never favour an arm

clustering.min_clusters_default_rationale: Cluster-robust and cluster-bootstrap coverage degrades sharply below roughly 20-30 independent clusters. Below this count the resampling distribution is a statement about a handful of structural templates, not about the generator distribution, so the gate is INCONCLUSIVE rather than a narrow interval.
clustering.absent_field_rule: if any episode in a gated sample carries no `template_cluster_id`, the registered clustering field is unavailable for that sample and the gate is INCONCLUSIVE. It is never silently clustered on task_id, and never silently clustered on the paraphrase `template_id`.

er.er67_stratum_note: ER6/ER7 read 'all core TP episodes' literally: the CORE stratum only, control `none`, conditions clean and faulted. MT and H8 augmentation traces are a different, separately-sized sample and must never dilute or inflate a core runaway/hallucination rate.
er.er8_min_per_group_note: ER8 requires ALL THREE registered groups to be present at their registered cardinality of 400 assigned episodes each. A missing or short group makes ER8 INCONCLUSIVE: 'no group fell below -0.05' computed over two of three groups is not the registered gate. This raises the earlier 300 to the registered 400 (a TIGHTENING, never a relaxation) and follows the frozen cross-agent cardinality contract; total assigned then stands at 1,200, still above the unchanged min_assigned_faults floor of 900.

mt.mt3_median_convention_note: For an EVEN sample the median is the upper middle order statistic, i.e. sorted[n//2] 0-based. Frozen because it is the convention the analyzer already implemented; the alternative `lower_middle` is also implemented so this field genuinely governs, but `upper_middle` is the registered value and is the more conservative of the two for an at-most gate.

floors.denominator: F1/F2 over the arm's CORE clean episodes with control `none`; F3/F4 over the arm's CORE faulted episodes with control `none` (intention-to-treat: every assigned fault episode stays in the denominator, including timeouts, parser failures, crashes and runaways); F5 over the union of those two core sets. MT and H8 augmentation, stress, redacted and permuted traces are OUTSIDE every floor denominator.
floors.estimator_note: Floors are POINT estimates, not interval bounds. Wilson intervals are still reported beside them for the reader, but the floor decision is the point rate against the threshold; this was the behaviour at registration and is frozen here so it cannot drift to an interval after results exist.

status_precedence.rule: BUG > FAIL > INCONCLUSIVE > PASS. A real FAIL outranks missing evidence; INCONCLUSIVE never reads as support; SKIP is FORBIDDEN in the agentic path and any unknown state is treated as BUG.
status_precedence.bug_overlay: Any harness BUG overlays EVERY official gate, floor, claim and winner status with BUG. The raw arithmetic survives only under the explicitly non-verdict field `observed_status` (plus `measured_status` where a gate had already been downgraded for underpower). No official field may read PASS anywhere in a verdict that contains a harness BUG.

controls_checks.s14_generation_check_cap_note: Number of specs whose hidden value is mutated to prove generation-time counterfactual sensitivity. A work cap, but a cap on evidence, so it is registered rather than left as an internal constant.

curves.note: DESCRIPTIVE only. H50 is reported solely when the OBSERVED curve crosses this rate; otherwise it is left- or right-censored. No logistic or other extrapolation is ever fitted.

machine.mandatory_harness_checks_note: All TWELVE registered vetoes are MANDATORY. A BUG in any of them makes the whole verdict BUG. An INCONCLUSIVE in any of them means NO VERDICT: a winner may not be declared while the harness that would make a winner meaningful is unverified. Before this was frozen the analyzer could ship a winner while S9, S10, S14 or S18 was INCONCLUSIVE. S19 HARDWARE-INTEGRITY is the twelfth and newest: it was added with the single-card pivot, when zero study GPU-hours and zero held-out results existed, and it can only veto a result or make it INCONCLUSIVE.

registered_cardinalities.note: EXACT counts, not minimums. These govern the suite generator (sibling layer); the analyzer's gate minimums above are the separate, unchanged decision thresholds. Where an exact cardinality exceeds a gate minimum the surplus is registered sampling, not slack to be trimmed after results.
registered_cardinalities.consumed_by: the suite generator and its cardinality tests own these; the analyzer reads absent_information_per_family_per_arm and the fault-group count, and reports every other cardinality it can observe in the emitted census

typed_relay_mt_contract.note: Every typed_relay MT task carries pattern_id in 0..5 (six registered tool-order patterns) and all_tools_required = true.

fault_protocol.assignment: deterministic per (task_id, fault_seed_eval); emitted exactly once at the registered critical oracle node on the first semantically valid call; always recoverable within the remaining registered budget; wrong_unit only on unit_convert nodes
fault_protocol.recovery_token: 128-bit HMAC(run_secret) token in every error envelope (transient, rate_limit, malformed); certification requires the token in the remedial call; rate_limit additionally requires a later assistant decision; wrong_unit emits no token and requires a corrected-target conversion
non_recovery_cases: blind_retry (post-fault result without the remediation contract)

sample_sizes.eval_core: 1200 held-out specs (100 per family/horizon cell over 12 cells), each run clean AND faulted per arm: >= 900 fault-assigned pairs, with the three registered fault groups at 400 assigned episodes EACH (1200 total). The 900 floor is unchanged; the per-group cardinality is raised from 300 to the registered 400 in machine.er.er8_min_per_group, which is a tightening.
sample_sizes.eval_mt: exactly 600 held-out typed-relay pairs at fixed H4 (six order patterns x 100), all three tools causally required, every task carrying pattern_id in 0..5 and all_tools_required true; >= 240 distinct `template_cluster_id` values with <= 5 value instantiations per cluster. The MT1 gate minimum stays at 600 pairs and >= 80 pairs per pattern (unchanged); 100 per pattern is the registered generation cardinality.
sample_sizes.eval_h8: >= 400 paired clean H8 instances (eval_core H8 cells plus augmentation, balanced across lookup_chain and typed_relay)
sample_sizes.stress: 280 two-fault tasks, >= 40 per cell at H >= 8, fault rate 2/H, measured-only
sample_sizes.no_enlargement: final-test sample sizes must not be enlarged after looking at results; if template dependence makes the design underpowered, the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE

absent_information.construction: the required lookup never returns the hidden value (hidden_key record removed); every scored task depends on an episode-specific hidden value of >= 48 bits entropy generated outside the prompt
absent_information.coverage_rule: n_per_family is required PER FAMILY PER ARM, counted separately for each (family, arm) cell -- not pooled across arms. Every family that appears in any gated sample must have redacted coverage in every arm; a family present in the capability numbers but absent from the control is missing coverage, and missing coverage is INCONCLUSIVE. Harness-failed traces (zero decisions / spec_error) do not count toward coverage and are a BUG in their own right, because zero success over episodes that never ran is vacuous.
absent_information.expectation: certified success exactly zero BY CONSTRUCTION; any raw exact success is a harness-leakage BUG (S11), never evidence of ability

counterfactual_permutation.n_per_arm_note: GENERATION cardinality consumed by the suite generator (sibling layer): exactly 100 permuted replays per arm. The analyzer's S14 gate threshold remains the unchanged registered `n_min` of 100 permuted replays; converting the gate to a per-arm count would change a threshold value, which the governance fix is forbidden to do.
counterfactual_permutation.construction: hidden terminal values permuted BETWEEN task IDs with permutation_seed; correct outputs must track the returned value, not the prompt/task identity (S14)
counterfactual_permutation.scope: token-answer tasks (terminal kb_lookup); all other scored tasks must carry a generation-time counterfactual_sensitive flag verified by the suite validator

controls.isolation: clean and injected replays run in isolated processes/caches so a clean result can never leak into the faulted replay

harness_vetoes.S8: PAIRING: identical task IDs, values, budgets, schemas, decoding, and seeds across compared arms
harness_vetoes.S19: HARDWARE-INTEGRITY (MANDATORY): every claim-bearing trace within one run_id carries the full runtime fingerprint (machine.hardware_integrity.required_trace_fields) and shares ONE physical GPU UUID; every paired BP/TP and B0/T0 comparison has an IDENTICAL hardware-and-engine fingerprint. MISSING hardware provenance -> INCONCLUSIVE and no winner. A known-wrong card, a mixed UUID/run_id/engine fingerprint, a paired-arm fingerprint mismatch, or an engine fingerprint that contradicts machine.engine_contract -> BUG. An independent replication on another A5000 requires a NEW run_id and may not append to an existing trace set.
harness_vetoes.S9: ORACLE: every task reachable; registered minimum horizon independently verified by replay
harness_vetoes.S10: SPLITS: no train/dev/test overlap in task IDs, KB namespace or keys, graph isomorphism, or template hashes
harness_vetoes.S11: ABSENT-INFO: redacted controls have zero certified AND zero raw exact success
harness_vetoes.S12: INJECTION: scheduled failures fire exactly once, at the registered critical dependency, and remain recoverable
harness_vetoes.S13: RECEIPTS: every certified outcome has a valid environment-only receipt chain (HMAC with the run secret)
harness_vetoes.S14: COUNTERFACTUAL: changing the hidden value changes the oracle answer and the scorer decision; permuted replays track the returned value
harness_vetoes.S15: ATTRITION: every assigned task has a trace; timeouts, parser failures, crashes, and runaways remain in denominators (missing traces -> INCONCLUSIVE, never favourable)
harness_vetoes.S16: CONTROL-INTEGRITY: base checkpoint and prompt hashes match this preregistration; no adapter loaded in prompt-only arms
harness_vetoes.S17: TRACE-SUMMARY: independent recomputation agrees on calls, failures, exposure, recovery, hallucinations, and final score
harness_vetoes.S18: TEST-BLINDNESS: checkpoint and prompt winners locked (results/agentic/locks.json) before the held-out seed reveal (results/agentic/seed_reveal.json)
harness_vetoes.precedence: any BUG vetoes every capability gate, every launch floor and the winner rule -- the raw arithmetic survives only under the non-verdict field `observed_status`, and no official field may read PASS in a verdict containing a BUG. Any mandatory veto left INCONCLUSIVE yields NO VERDICT: a winner may not ship while the harness that would make it meaningful is unverified. Missing traces or an underpowered common-clean subset yield INCONCLUSIVE, never a favourable interpretation.

launch_floors.F3: overall faulted strict success (intention-to-treat over assigned faults) >= 0.40

budget.ceiling_hardware: measured RTX A5000 GPU-hours (one physical card; see hardware and machine.hardware_integrity)
budget.ceiling_note: 120.0 MEASURED A5000 GPU-hours summed over every GPU stage of the whole pipeline. Measured, not nominal: a stage's own wall-clock GPU seconds are appended to the ledger, and a caller-supplied projection is never accepted as the accounting record. Server startup, compilation and CUDA-graph capture count as measured occupancy.

ceiling_derivation.why_raised: The mandatory BP/TP paired evaluation -- which may never shrink -- projects to 75-99 A5000 GPU-hours from DIRECTLY MEASURED prior evaluator rates. Keeping 36.0 would not have made the work cheaper; it would have silently forced a mandatory-sample shrinkage, which this preregistration forbids. Raising an accounting envelope before any GPU-hour is spent is legitimate; shrinking a mandatory sample after a number is visible is not.

measured_rates.base_arm_basis: prior measured base evaluation 5019.8 s / 200 episodes
measured_rates.trained_arm_basis: prior measured RS-SFT evaluation 8854 s / 200 episodes

ceiling_derivation.chosen_ceiling_rationale: 120.0 is the forecaster's minimum defensible PRE-CALIBRATION budget: it covers the 87-118 h evidence envelope with a small margin and no contingency padding beyond it.
ceiling_derivation.engineering_target_status: UNVALIDATED EXPECTATION, NEVER A REGISTERED MEASUREMENT. If the new concurrent vLLM evaluator validates a 3.3-3.9x speedup over the old serial evaluator, the whole program may finish in about 14-21 h. That number may not be cited as a measured cost, may not be used to justify a smaller ceiling, and may not be entered into the ledger. Only measured seconds are accounting.
ceiling_derivation.outcome_blind: Recorded when the gpu ledger was empty, no checkpoint existed, and no held-out result existed. The derivation follows measured evaluator rates and a declared hardware change, never an observed model outcome.

budget.dominant_stage_evidence: The final paired evaluation, NOT GRPO, is the stage most likely to consume the ceiling: 75-99 projected A5000 GPU-hours for the 7800 mandatory BP/TP episodes at the directly measured 25.10 s/episode (base) and 44.27 s/episode (trained) rates. The earlier 'around seven GPU-hours at ~7.85 decision-generations/s' estimate translated a fully batched rejection-sampling rate into dependency-serial online tool episodes and is superseded as a forecast; the registered episode counts it referred to are unchanged. If continuous batching is validated, production rejection sampling (about 16400 rollouts, mean H about 9.07) becomes the largest stage instead -- which is exactly why calibration is load-bearing.

mandatory_episode_census.note: CORRECTED mandatory census: 7800 episodes. The registered H8 denominator is 400 paired tasks, but 200 of those are already inside eval_core, so only 200 are ADDITIONAL. The absent-information and permutation controls are registered as CLEAN controls; adding faulted controls would be a NEW pre-registration choice and is deliberately not made here. No registered cardinality changed: this corrects an arithmetic census, not a sample size.

episode_projection.with_r0_rp: not applicable: R0/RP are absent by design

mandatory.rule: BP and TP across core (clean and faulted), MT, H8 and ALL controls are MANDATORY -- 7800 episodes (budget.mandatory_episode_census). Mandatory sample sizes may NEVER shrink after any result is visible -- not by one episode, and not for a stated budget reason discovered after a number was seen.
mandatory.infeasibility_rule: If the mandatory work cannot fit inside the 120.0-hour ceiling, the run STOPS and reports INCOMPLETE / INCONCLUSIVE. It does not trim a mandatory sample, does not substitute a smaller sample, and does not report a partial mandatory sample as if it were the registered one. An unfinished run is a reportable outcome; a silently shrunk one is not.

cut_order_if_calibration_projects_overru.cut: the entire GRPO branch (multigrpo training and every GRPO-derived arm)
the GRPO variance probe and the R0/RP evaluation arms

budget.cut_order_rule: Cuts are taken in this order and only this order, and only on a CALIBRATION projection made before the relevant stage runs -- never after seeing a held-out result from any arm. Everything in this list is declared budget-conditional HERE, before the push, which is the only thing that makes dropping it honest. Anything not in this list is mandatory. THE ORDER IS UNCHANGED BY THE HARDWARE PIVOT.
budget.cut_order_status_note: Ranks 1 and 2 (the GRPO branch, its variance probe and the R0/RP arms) are now moot rather than reordered: GRPO is NOT RUN at all under grpo.stage_disposition GRPO_NOT_RUN_HARDWARE_INFEASIBLE, and the variance probe is NOT_EVALUATED_HARDWARE_SHORT_CIRCUIT. The first cut actually available to a calibration overrun is therefore rank 3 (B0/T0), then rank 4 (stress). Nothing was promoted, demoted or reclassified; no mandatory arm becomes optional, and no optional arm becomes mandatory.

calibration.rule: Before the final paired evaluation, measure completed episodes/hour AND decision-generations/hour separately for the base and adapter arms, stratified by horizon (H2/H4/H8/H12/H14/H20) and by clean/faulted, and project the remaining registered work from those measurements including server restarts. The projection is a measurement, not an estimate supplied by the caller.
calibration.decision_point: if the projection for mandatory work alone exceeds the remaining ledger budget, apply the cut order; if mandatory work alone still does not fit, STOP and report INCOMPLETE
calibration.load_bearing_note: Calibration is LOAD-BEARING under the 120.0-hour ceiling: the pre-calibration evidence envelope (87-118 h) and the unvalidated concurrent-evaluator expectation (14-21 h) differ by roughly 5x, and which of them is true decides whether the mandatory program fits. Calibration runs on dev-only task IDs, before the held-out seed reveal, on the exact production engine contract; concurrency is selected from timing, OOM/preemption and latency stability ONLY, never from a capability outcome.
calibration.if_mandatory_still_does_not_fit: STOP and report INCOMPLETE / INCONCLUSIVE. Mandatory samples may never shrink.

ledger.accounting_rule: Every GPU stage appends one append-only record carrying stage name, start and end UTC timestamps, MEASURED elapsed GPU seconds, git sha, the full hardware fingerprint of machine.hardware_integrity.required_trace_fields (GPU name, GPU UUID, CUDA-visible bytes, driver version, engine fingerprint, effective thinking mode, run_id, config hash), and the episode or step count actually completed. The ceiling is enforced against the SUM of measured elapsed GPU seconds over all records, never against nominal per-stage ranges. A stage may not start when its calibrated projection plus the ledger total would cross 120.0 hours. Server startup, compilation and CUDA-graph capture count as measured occupancy. A shard that overruns its projection is still charged its measured time, and the overrun is reported rather than absorbed. Every GPU consumer -- including the final evaluator -- must read and append to this ledger; a stage that does not appear in the ledger counts as unaccounted time and makes the budget claim INCONCLUSIVE. A ledger row whose GPU UUID disagrees with the first bound UUID of the run is fatal.

grpo.status: NOT RUN in this registered run: the exact registered recipe is HARDWARE-INFEASIBLE on the registered single RTX A5000. It remains OPTIONAL and budget-conditional (cut rank 1) as a matter of registration; the disposition below is why it is not executed. Nothing in the primary or secondary claims depends on GRPO running. The registered hyperparameters below are UNCHANGED -- an infeasible recipe is still the registered recipe, and rewriting it would define a different experiment.

stage_disposition.label: GRPO_NOT_RUN_HARDWARE_INFEASIBLE
stage_disposition.kind_rule: A stage disposition says what happened to a STAGE. It is NEVER one of the capability gate states PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE / BUG, is never written into any gate, claim, floor or winner field, and is deliberately absent from outcome_states. Reporting it as a gate state would turn 'the trainer could not start' into a statement about the model.
stage_disposition.variance_probe_rule: The probe is NOT RUN and its status is NOT_EVALUATED_HARDWARE_SHORT_CIRCUIT. It may never be described as 'closed': a closed gate would be evidence about the RS-SFT policy's variance, and no such evidence exists. The distinct label GRPO_NOT_RUN_VARIANCE_GATE_CLOSED is reserved for the case where the complete 144-group probe ran and a binding pooled gate failed.

arithmetic.conclusion: 0.24 x 23.546 GiB = 5.651 GiB is smaller than vLLM's own 8.455 GiB colocated policy copy, so the engine cannot even instantiate; and the trainer's 9.420 GiB plus that copy is already 17.875 GiB of 23.546 GiB before any KV cache, CUDA graphs, or the 1.53 GiB-per-3072-token-sequence logits. The registered configuration is infeasible, not merely tight.

frozen_preconditions: the registered hardware is exactly one NVIDIA RTX A5000 with 25282805760 CUDA-visible bytes

the registered GRPO recipe is UNCHANGED: bf16 Qwen3.5-4B, LoRA r=32, 8 generations, per-device batch 4, accumulation 2, max_completion_length 3072, vllm_max_model_length 6144, vllm_gpu_memory_utilization 0.24
a DETERMINISTIC preflight records that the 5.651 GiB vLLM allocation is smaller than the 8.455 GiB independent policy copy
NO optimizer step and NO held-out evaluation precedes this disposition

NO substituted variant runs under the same registered branch: not microbatch 1, not 2048-token completions, not no-vLLM generation, not quantization, not offload, not an alternate optimizer, not another card
a DURABLE artifact (results/agentic/grpo_disposition.json) records GPU name, CUDA-visible bytes, config hash, checkpoint hash, git SHA, the arithmetic, the UTC time and zero GRPO optimizer steps
no GRPO checkpoint exists; R0/RP are ABSENT BY DESIGN; RS-SFT is the SOLE trained candidate eligible for the checkpoint lock
stage_disposition.artifact_contract: machine.grpo_disposition (the copy the analyzer reads). The analyzer REQUIRES this artifact whenever locks.json locks a trained checkpoint whose stage is not `grpo`: a missing GRPO checkpoint with no allowed disposition is a BUG and must never silently select RS-SFT.
stage_disposition.out_of_v1_scope: agentlab.multigrpo is NOT written and the GRPO branch is out of v1 scope. A future GRPO study on different hardware, or with a redesigned batch, is a SEPARATE pre-registration with its own locks, seeds, ledger and hardware declaration.
stage_disposition.outcome_blind: Registered when zero study GPU-hours and zero held-out results existed. The disposition follows from a memory arithmetic over declared hardware, never from an observed model outcome.

grpo.scenario_seed_rule: GRPO training data is a MAP-STYLE dataset keyed by `scenario_seed`. Every one of the G generations in a group must reconstruct byte-identically the same prompt, KB, environment, fault target, fault class, node index and budgets from that single `scenario_seed`; ONLY the sampling seed differs across the group. A group whose members cannot be shown to share one reconstructed scenario is discarded, not repaired.

variance_probe.must_exist_before_grpo: src/agentlab/variance.py, run on the locked RS-SFT checkpoint BEFORE any GRPO update, on a disjoint committed probe split, using the EXACT GRPO decoding settings and the EXACT production reward function (one shared reward implementation, imported by both the probe and GRPO).
variance_probe.sampling: eight distinct committed sampling seeds per group; every non-sampling input identical

binding_gates.aggregation_note: The two binding gates are evaluated POOLED, once, over all groups. Per-family figures are reported descriptively and MAY NOT become an eligibility route: allowing 'the gate passes for family X' would turn per-family reporting into post-hoc family selection.
binding_gates.nonzero_sd_definition: sample standard deviation of the TOTAL reward (every component summed and the final clamp applied) across the eight members, counted as nonzero when SD > 1e-12
binding_gates.disagreement_definition: both at least one strict success AND at least one strict failure appear among the eight members. Not raw-answer disagreement. For faulted groups terminal success additionally requires CERTIFIED recovery, including token use and any later-decision requirement.
binding_gates.denominator_rule: failed, crashed, truncated and no-commit rollouts stay in every denominator
binding_gates.reporting: numerator, denominator, fraction and Wilson interval for each of the two gates

diagnostic_only.clip_frac_definition: length-truncated / clipped completions. Before an optimizer step there is no PPO/DAPO policy-ratio clipping, so a ratio-clipping reading of this number is meaningless in the probe; if policy-ratio clipping is ever wanted it belongs to a short GRPO preflight, not here.
diagnostic_only.status: DIAGNOSTIC / OPERATIONAL preflight conditions ONLY. These are NOT scientific gates and are NOT preregistered claims; they were unregistered values in the retired multifaceted.yaml and are recorded here as operational readiness checks so that neither they nor their absence can be presented as evidence.

variance_probe.provenance: record checkpoint hash, prompt hash, config hash, suite SHA256SUMS hash, git sha, model and server versions, GPU identity, elapsed GPU seconds and the exact group IDs; also report unique completion hashes so that accidentally reusing one seed eight times is detectable

dev_selection.this_run: Hardware-infeasible GRPO leaves RS-SFT as the SOLE trained candidate: there is no second candidate, so no dev comparison is performed and the tie rule below is never reached. The rule stays registered verbatim because a future run that does produce a GRPO checkpoint must implement it, and because deleting it would let 'RS-SFT was locked' look like the outcome of a comparison that never happened.
dev_selection.rule: EXACTLY ONE trained checkpoint is locked as TP. The selection between RS-SFT and GRPO is made on the committed DEV split only, before the held-out seed reveal, and recorded in results/agentic/locks.json with its stage.
dev_selection.metric: mean certified strict success on the committed dev split, pooling clean and faulted dev episodes with equal weight per episode, under the frozen decoding settings and the frozen tournament-winner prompt
dev_selection.tie_rule: if the two checkpoints differ by less than 0.005 absolute on that metric, the tie goes to RS-SFT (the shorter, cheaper pipeline). A tie NEVER goes to GRPO, so an unresolved comparison cannot manufacture a GRPO claim.
dev_selection.one_checkpoint_rule: locks.json must name exactly one checkpoint path with exactly one stage from `stages`; every TP and T0 trace must carry that path as its adapter. More than one trained candidate, a missing stage, or an adapter that disagrees with the lock is a harness BUG (S16).

truth_table.condition: any mandatory harness check is BUG
any mandatory harness check is INCONCLUSIVE
exactly one locked trained checkpoint (rs_sft or grpo) maps to TP
truth_table.verdict: precondition; a missing or ambiguous lock is a BUG (S16)

truth_table.condition: TP clears EVERY launch floor AND ER4 PASS AND ER2 PASS
otherwise BP clears every launch floor
truth_table.verdict: BP ships -- including when the trained comparison FAILS and when it is underpowered

truth_table.condition: floor evidence is incomplete (any floor INCONCLUSIVE)

winner_rule.W1: the trained arm becomes the shipped default ONLY if it clears every launch floor AND is clean-non-inferior at -0.03 (ER4) AND certified recovery clustered LB > +0.05 (ER2)
winner_rule.W2: otherwise the frozen prompted base (BP) ships if it clears every launch floor
winner_rule.W3: otherwise the honest verdict is: no successful multifaceted pipeline yet
winner_rule.veto: no winner is declared while any mandatory harness veto is BUG or INCONCLUSIVE
winner_rule.evaluation_order: ranks are evaluated in order and the first matching rank decides; there is no discretion left anywhere in the table

claims_to_reject: the model can plan arbitrary eight-step tasks
the model is robust to arbitrary tool/API failures
training beats prompt engineering (without the fixed eight-prompt qualification)
the learned policy understands why recovery works
GRPO improves RS-SFT (unless separately preregistered and powered as a paired stage-attribution experiment)
success continues beyond horizon eight (extrapolating a fitted curve is not falsification)
broad BFCL or tau-bench claims via judge models, user simulators, remote APIs, or contaminated public tasks
successful dependency-chain execution reveals an internal planning mechanism (the protocol supports a narrow behavioural claim only)
